title: Chapter 483
paragraphs: Chapter 483
Episode 134. Duel on the Ship (5)
Mary's venomous snake was already lunging forward.
The target was set and only a single point of her sword's tip and electric energy had made contact, but her blurred vision cleared first.
'Damn!'
She couldn't see her youngest brother, who had been obscured by the electric energy.
A ridiculously affectionate youngest brother who would put down his sword because he couldn't kill his beloved sister never existed in the first place.
'Where is he!'
As is often the case with those who realize their mistakes, she gritted her teeth in frustration. An indescribable cold aura seemed to cut through her entire body.
If she didn't withdraw her sword, she would die.
Her instincts told her so. The experiences gained from thousands of battles also alerted her to the same danger.
She had to withdraw it, even though the Orer would inevitably flow back. She had to somehow withdraw it and locate her youngest brother first.
A light-speed thrust, a sword piercing the sky. Naturally, withdrawing such power would be accompanied by an immense backlash.
Kuaaak-!

Changing her motion, Mary let out a scream. Her hand gripping the sword, her arm, and shoulder, as well as her waist and lower body muscles and bones felt like they were going to break with trembling sensations.
She withdrew.
The progress of the light-speed thrust tearing through the electric energy stopped as if it were a lie. The electric energy surged back like a wave, and the flashing lights disrupted her vision.
Turning her body to the back, in a split second, Mary could sense that the scattered energy nearby was not just electric energy.
Dark curtains.

The electric energy's hemisphere was covering the spiritual energy. From the beginning, Jin had spread the electric energy only to hide the curtains of spiritual energy for his Shadow Stealth technique.
She threw the retrieved venomous snake in all directions to secure her vision. As the electric energy cleared, the dark curtains momentarily came into view.
'Four, no. Seven!'
She thought that a pitch-black sword energy would shoot out at any moment.
However, the curtains were just floating still, and there were no other movements yet. Instead, Mary turned her body to the side.
'There he is!'
Jin was charging at her. The distance was closing with every flash of electric energy and every blink of her eyes. Together with the darkened Brada Manta.
Swoosh-!
Eventually, Brada Manta and the venomous snake clashed.
It seemed like they had clashed. Despite her internal injuries, Mary displayed extraordinary strength to perfectly respond to Jin's surprise attack.
However, the venomous snake missed. The massive sword energy that spread out like a fan pierced through the electric energy and disappeared into the sky.
Mary couldn't help but be bewildered once again.
'He was right in front of me...!'
It was as if he was a ghost or had teleported.
Just before their blades collided, the youngest brother somehow pushed his sword towards his own rear.
The shadows scattered around the two were a kind of 'door', accessible only to Jin, who used the Shadow Stealth technique.
That was precisely why Jin could once again grasp Mary's rear. He had crossed over the curtain just before the collision.
'Sister is a monster after all.'
Blood splattered.
It was Mary's blood. Brada Manta, which had aimed for her neck, barely grazed her shoulder.
'I thought I could at least shatter her shoulder.'
The venomous snake also grazed Jin's cheek. Due to the curtains of electric and spiritual energy, the battle was now completely invisible from the outside.
However, everyone heard the thunderous sound of the two swords colliding and the siblings screaming and shouting.
And everyone felt it instinctively. When the spiritual and electric energy subsided, the one standing would be the winner.
Kaaaak-!
With each of Mary's roars, the hemisphere of electric energy seemed to tremble as if tearing apart. Jin poured out a torrent of attacks to prevent his sister from gathering strength again.
'If I give her even a moment's gap, I don't know what kind of technique she'll use.'
Just before Mary unfolded her fourth light-speed thrust, Jin felt an inexplicable sense of foreboding.
It was the incomplete 'Fifth' technique, not the dark secret technique she originally intended to use. He didn't know that fact, but just like Mary, his instincts alerted him to the danger.
He had to relentlessly attack. To make sure Mary couldn't even imagine that there was one more trick up his sleeve.
Heaving and panting, it wasn't just Mary who was out of breath. Jin's stamina was also draining.

Although he didn't use the real King's Domain Sword, he rapidly consumed electric energy at a comparable level, so it was impossible not to be exhausted. In terms of stamina, Mary was slightly better off.
Gritting his teeth and shouting, Jin thought, 'It's about time for this to start, how is she still holding on?'
What he was waiting for was none other than:
Counterflow.
'No matter how much she is my sister, there's no way her body can be fine after withdrawing her light-speed thrust like that.'
Cough-!
As soon as the thought ended, Mary spat out a clot of blood and bent her waist.
The moment to end the match had come.
Jin advanced to Mary's front and lunged with Brada Manta. Mary mustered her last focus to read her brother's attack trajectory.
Brada Manta, which was raised diagonally, was aiming for Mary's neck.
Mary almost missed its trajectory, but she managed to raise her sword to block it.
Up to that point, Jin had predicted the outcome. He expected that Mary, being a superhuman of her caliber, would naturally be able to reach this point.
'She's counterattacking amidst all this...!'
However, he didn't expect her to not only block but also counterattack.
To be precise, Mary didn't exactly 'block' Jin's final strike.
Spiritual Sword, Second Form: Scissors.
Jin's last trick was the scissor-like black blade that formed on the opposite side of the diagonal line drawn by Brada Manta.
In the end, Mary couldn't block the last black blade of the scissors.
Shaaa...!
The blade formed by spiritual energy grazed Mary's face and passed by.
What the blade cut was the pirate eyepatch she was wearing. If it had aimed for her neck instead of the eyepatch, it could have been enough.
'It's over, sister.'
From the beginning, Jin had foreseen victory the moment Mary withdrew her light-speed thrust. However, he never let his guard down until the very end.
Because his opponent was Mary Run Kandel.
But the fact that Mary counterattacked at the last moment would be remembered by Jin as a chilling experience for a long time to come.
Mary Run Kandel, the
seventh generation of the family. Regardless of her relationship with the high priest, she was considered the most daunting opponent when all the siblings fought for their lives.
As the fog lifted, the electric and spiritual energy that covered the battlefield disappeared instantly.
Swooosh-!
Suddenly, a stream of water fell from the sky. The water fell from a massive barrier of water formed by a part of the sea splitting behind Jin.
That was the trace left by Mary's last counterattack.
"What happened?"
"Did you see that?"
Cosmos and the pirates, the crowd, and the majority of Jin's comrades didn't know why the water barrier formed.
Only those who had reached the ranks of superhumans were aware that Mary had 'swung her sword'.
"Ha, that Mary. How did she swing her sword at the last moment?"
"…I didn't get a very detailed look either, Lord Murakan."
"Whatever it was, if she had properly swung at the kid, the outcome could have changed."
Murakan and Balkas spoke, and Jin swallowed his saliva.
'I thought it was a simple counterattack, but it was faster than light-speed thrust… No, even if I had known beforehand, it would have been an almost divine slash that I could never have avoided.'
Run Kandel's Fifth.

Jin immediately confirmed that the last slash that passed by him was one of the three Fives of the family swordsmanship. It was evident that it wasn't complete. If it had been a complete Fifth, he wouldn't be standing.
Swoooooosh-, the water barrier crumbled like a sandcastle and returned to the sea.
"Both of them seem to be standing just fine! But the fight is over...! Neither Mary nor Jin are moving!"
Cosmos shouted, his eyes wide in excitement.
The siblings locked eyes with each other, their swords still aimed at one another.
Wobble!
As Mary knelt on one knee, sighs of disappointment could be heard from the crowd.
"Damn it! I didn't expect to be fooled by your tricks like this...!"
Mary spat out blood and wiped her forehead. At that moment, Cosmos announced the result of the match with fireworks from all directions.
"The winner is! Jin Runecandel! This was a once-in-a-lifetime, scorching-hot match! Everyone, please respond with applause!"
Amid thunderous applause, Jin approached Mary and extended his hand.
"Why did you try to finish with a lightspeed thrust instead of using the Oui technique? If you had used the Oui then, I would have been the one to lose."

"I thought you didn't want to kill me and so you held back your sword. I didn't think it was worth showing off, but I momentarily forgot that you wouldn't back down like that. Damn, I can't believe I fell for that."

"It's the same tactic I used against the guardian modeled after the former Knight Commander Sara Runecandel. Since she wasn't in good health, she couldn't break through it, but I can't be sure if it would have worked against you if you had used the Oui."
"Heh, are you comparing me to an old saint of the family to console your sister?"
"Maybe you're just a little twisted."
"Hehe, it seems I was the one who backed down."
Mary took Jin's hand and got up. Despite her words, she looked quite refreshed.
"...Jin, my brother."
"Yes, sister."
"Today, you have officially defeated the 7th generation of our family."
"Wasn't there too many restrictions on both of us for it to be a fair match?"

"True, I fought with an eyepatch the entire time, and you refrained from using magic. But what does it matter? You never let your guard down until the very end, and I misjudged you and brought defeat upon myself. That alone proves that you are stronger than me."
Jin didn't respond, and Mary let out a playful laugh.
"So, starting today, you are the 5th in the family hierarchy. Hold the position well, as I will reclaim it after enough training. And in that sense... Hey! Cosmos!"
"Yes!"
"Bring that here."
At Mary's command, Cosmos hurriedly brought something out from his pocket. What he handed over politely was a book.
Jin couldn't help but widen his eyes and even open his mouth foolishly as he saw the author of the book.
The 5th Secret Technique: Lightspeed Thrust - Shiron Runecandel
It was the training manual for the lightspeed thrust technique that Shiron had written for Mary.
"It wouldn't make sense for the 5th in the family hierarchy not to know one of the family's secret techniques, would it?"
As Jin held the training manual, he couldn't hide his astonishment.
